== Slack #announcements additions (2020-04 to 2020-11) ==
* Star Wars CCG Slack, <code>#announcements</code>, Players Committee Twitter feed (<code>@swccg</code>), 1 April – 10 November 2020 — March and May–August monthly qualifiers, two seasonal at-large bids, Top 16 playoff seeds and planet pods, and reported Round of 16, Quarterfinal, Semifinal, and Final Confrontation pairings/results. The 31 August 2020 tweet gives "pmyers (11-10)" (apparent typo under the 12-game monthly cap), so prose omits the numerical W–L record while quoting the tweet in the reference; unmapped handle <code>tge_damen</code> is left in quotes.
